profile     login-host
            complete /login on the host
defined in  {config}/snug/profiles.d/login-host.toml

  login            claude = "host"
                   opens Claude's login page in YOUR browser when the sandbox
                   asks; a login you approve is completed on the host and
                   REWRITES ~/.claude/.credentials.json there, and the sandbox
                   gets an access token only

To see what this actually produces for a directory:
  snug --dry-run -p login-host <dir>
